finding: After creating storage-compression and payload, only child directories were fsynced. The entry of the new restoration root in R was not durably synced before originals could be unlinked.
impact: A crash could lose the restoration root directory entry after original unlink was durable, despite verified gzip and durable map files within the new directory.
repair: After both mkdir calls, sync_dir(out) and sync_dir(R), before preflight/compression/original unlink.
scope: Only this unfrozen delivery helper; runtime, frozen execution files, original evidence, model and reference unchanged.
